stemMd: For which k does the system x + y = 4 and 2x + 2y = k have infinitely many solutions?
explanationMd: The second left side is exactly twice the first. For the equations to describe the same line, the second right side must be 2 × 4 = 8. Then there is only one independent equation in two variables and infinitely many solutions.

distractorRationale.b: The second left side is twice the first, so its right side must also double.
distractorRationale.e: This divides the first constant rather than doubling it.
distractorRationale.c: This contradicts twice the first equation.
distractorRationale.a: All other values produce inconsistent parallel constraints.
